review_scope: Human decision surface only; local synthetic evidence only. No semantic values, source records, payloads, schema, adapter or runner are created.
source_basis_scope: The implementation design pins 14 existing decision, evidence, runtime and baseline references. Preserve and verify those hashes transitively; no partition or holdout artifact is a source for this packet.

decision_model.supersedes: v1 coupled semantic design approval to exact source references that did not yet exist. Exact instantiation references are now Stage-2 requirements, not Stage-1 prerequisites.
decision_model.field_mapping: All 14 required_human_decisions and nested human_decision fields are Stage-1 design decisions. All evidence_source_artifact/hash/source_location fields are Stage-2 submission slots, not selected sources or prerequisites for design approval.

stage_1.name: HUMAN_SEMANTIC_SOURCE_DESIGN_DECISION
stage_1.required_design_resolution: Human resolved semantic choices, admissible synthetic evidence construction rules and the permitted finite non-holdout scope in this signed decision.

stage_2.name: HUMAN_SOURCE_INSTANTIATION_REVIEW
stage_2.prerequisite: Explicit Stage-1 approval followed by exact frozen synthetic sources instantiated only within the approved design and non-holdout scope.
stage_2.acceptance_rule: Human verifies instantiated records against the approved design, exact bindings, source and policy hashes, and independent expected values/digests. Reject or leave unresolved any missing, ambiguous, mismatched or design-deviating item.
stage_2.approval_effect: Only explicit Stage-2 approval with a valid derived authority chain makes exact reviewed source values eligible for later payload construction. It does not authorize implementation or payload construction itself; return for separate non-holdout implementation authorization.

decision_model.transition_rule: No automatic stage approval. Stage-1 approval permits source instantiation, not source acceptance. Software then submits frozen source evidence for separate Stage-2 human review; no candidate value is resolved merely because artifacts exist or hashes match.

authority_derivation_contract.mirror_rule: Compatibility fields are derived displays only, never authority inputs. Require exact equality including null to canonical fields; divergence is BLOCK_DECISION_ACTIVATION. Never prefer, copy back or reconcile one representation automatically.
authority_derivation_contract.manual_effective_flags: Reject manually supplied effective/current authority booleans as authorization evidence. Rules produce ephemeral results from canonical decisions and independently validated evidence; never read cached results back as inputs.
authority_derivation_contract.pending_encoding: null only; null/missing/unknown decision never authorizes
authority_derivation_contract.evaluation: Each all_of is a strict Boolean conjunction of named validated predicates or earlier rule results. Missing, unknown, failed or non-Boolean predicates evaluate false. No fallback or truthiness coercion. Validate the complete rule graph against this reviewed contract before use.

predicate_contracts.stage_1_explicit_approve: Canonical Stage-1 decision equals APPROVE exactly; never derived from per-decision approvals.
predicate_contracts.stage_1_signature_present: Canonical Stage-1 human signature is a nonempty non-whitespace string identifying the reviewer; presence alone is not authentication or approval.
predicate_contracts.stage_1_date_present: Canonical Stage-1 date is a nonempty non-whitespace human-supplied string; preserve exact supplied text. Absence blocks.
predicate_contracts.all_14_required_decisions_approved: Exactly the 14 reviewed IDs occur once each; each canonical per-decision value is APPROVE. Missing, extra, duplicate, REJECT, LEAVE_UNRESOLVED or invalid values fail.
predicate_contracts.representations_consistent: Every equality and selection invariant in consistency_contract passes; no unresolved selection or unreviewed policy replacement on approval.
predicate_contracts.stage_1_scope_exact: Signed scope is exactly non-holdout synthetic source instantiation including independent non-executable reference derivation, confined to the explicit human-approved case/fixture allowlist and policy designs. No additional implementation or execution permission.
predicate_contracts.stage_1_design_complete: Every required semantic design has an explicit approved policy reference/version and resolved allowed choice; Stage-1 scope allowlist has explicit non-holdout membership basis. Missing meaning, scope or decision blocks, but no Stage-2 artifact hash is required.
predicate_contracts.packet_integrity_references_valid: Validate packet structure, exact decision IDs, policy/reference pointers, all pinned basis hashes and separately recorded human approval of the signed design snapshot. No self-asserted integrity flag or hash inside its own signed snapshot. Current source bytes must match approval; any revision needs renewed review.
predicate_contracts.stage_2_explicit_approve: Canonical Stage-2 decision equals APPROVE exactly, independently of Stage 1.
predicate_contracts.stage_2_signature_present: Canonical Stage-2 human signature is a nonempty non-whitespace string; no inherited Stage-1 signature.
predicate_contracts.stage_2_date_present: Canonical Stage-2 human date is a nonempty non-whitespace string; no inherited Stage-1 date.
predicate_contracts.stage_2_review_contract_passes: All seven required submission categories are present and separately human-reviewed against the exact Stage-1 approval reference and permitted scope; empty placeholders or mere existence of artifacts fail.
predicate_contracts.all_stage_2_matches: Independently recheck raw artifact hashes, exact locators, case/fixture bindings, policy/version hashes, expected values/digests and manifest dependency closure against the approved Stage-2 snapshot. Partial matches fail.
predicate_contracts.reviewed_sources_unchanged: Rehash the same approved source snapshots and dependencies before use; any source or policy change since Stage-2 approval fails. No updating expected hashes to fit new bytes.

authority_derivation_contract.aggregate_stage_1_rule: Every required decision APPROVE plus consistency/design/scope/integrity checks permits the HUMAN to approve Stage 1; software never changes the aggregate decision. Any required REJECT, LEAVE_UNRESOLVED, missing or invalid decision blocks aggregate approval.
authority_derivation_contract.denial: False derived authority means no action. Divergent mirrors -> BLOCK_DECISION_ACTIVATION; inconsistent required decisions/choices -> BLOCK_STAGE_1_APPROVAL. Preserve human entries and report, never repair.
authority_derivation_contract.effective_execution_authorized_for_new_b: The legacy top-level false is a deny-only historical display, not an authorization input. Any true value is incompatible with this packet and blocks activation. Execution requires a separate future authorization outside this decision model.

consistency_contract.policy_mirrors: For each required_human_decisions entry, policy_ref/human_decision must equal its canonical decision exactly, including null. If detail_ref exists, its human_decision must also match. IDs and pointers must resolve uniquely and source policy fields must match the declared decision subject.
consistency_contract.choice_resolution: APPROVE requires exactly one listed approve_choice; null or REJECT decision requires null choice. LEAVE_UNRESOLVED requires null choice or literal LEAVE_UNRESOLVED only where listed in that specialized choices domain. No recommendation is a selection.
consistency_contract.semantic_resolution: Approval of schema_valid or contradiction_score requires every human_resolution slot to reference the corresponding fully specified proposed_design member, or a separately explicit versioned replacement design. Null slots block approval. No exact Stage-2 paths/hashes needed here.
consistency_contract.aggregate_resolution: Canonical aggregate APPROVE is inconsistent unless all 14 per-decisions are APPROVE and every required selection/design/scope slot is resolved. All per-decisions APPROVE with aggregate null remains pending and has no effective authority.
consistency_contract.reconciliation: NONE; never infer, normalize, repair or overwrite human decisions

membership_basis_reference.byte_identity: Historical artifact verified byte-identical at frozen and current revision; no independent candidate-space enumeration is claimed.

stage_1_scope_design.approval_requirement: Human supplies explicit finite case_id + fixture_id scope and an approved non-holdout identity membership basis. These are scope design inputs, not yet-instantiated semantic source artifacts. No wildcard, first-fixture fallback, automatic prefix inference or holdout membership.
stage_1_scope_design.reference_derivation_included: Only INDEPENDENT_EXPECTED_INPUT_DERIVATION as non-executable source-review evidence; no executable runtime payload.

policy_identity_contract.stage_1: Human approves the proposed policy identity, design version, full meaning and instantiation procedure. Identity/version label is not itself approval. Proposed definitions below are named design metadata, not instantiated sources or validators.
policy_identity_contract.stage_2: Review exact frozen policy artifact path, SHA-256, record locators and candidate bindings; no nonexistent Stage-2 hash is a Stage-1 prerequisite.
policy_identity_contract.null_policy_artifact_hash: Stage-2 submission slot only; not a semantic placeholder. Approval binds design snapshot externally before source instantiation.

stage_1_semantic_designs.common_binding: Every synthetic claim, evidence item, inventory and assessment names exact case_id + fixture_id, immutable object identity and content digest. No lexical ID matching or evaluator-derived evidence. Ambiguous/missing/corrupt/unbound input always blocks.

claim_family.classification_subject: The explicitly authored claim's quantified scope and requested judgment, as documented by a separate human-reviewable classification rationale; never the resulting verifier/disposition.

criteria.universal: Claim asserts validity for every member of an open/unbounded population or all future states outside a finite enumerated evidence scope. A finite generalization does not certify that assertion.
criteria.human: Bounded claim explicitly requests discretionary review/choice that cannot be decided solely by checking a closed documentary rule or a factual support relation.
criteria.semantic: Bounded descriptive proposition asking whether finite identified evidence supports or contradicts factual content; it asserts neither permission nor a discretionary decision.
criteria.permission: Bounded proposition that a specific fictional request/tool/action is permitted by an identified synthetic permission/authority record; not a real-world authorization.

claim_family.algorithm: Require a frozen claim statement, explicit scope and judgment kind plus rationale demonstrating exactly one criterion. If multiple criteria apply, the claim is compound: BLOCK and request separate human-authored claims; do not prioritize or split automatically. If no criterion applies, BLOCK. Explicit metadata must be corroborated by the statement and rationale, not inferred from field names.
claim_family.instantiation: Instantiate only a mapping supported by this unique criterion and approved authored claim/rationale. Existing logical_family may be considered only with independently demonstrated exact semantic equivalence and explicit human choice; no automatic map.

proof_available.qualification: A documentary witness is a frozen attributed synthetic record containing an explicit finite assertion and its evidence subject. A finite derivation additionally enumerates premises, the explicit rule at each step and the resulting assertion. Both require complete references, candidate/fixture/claim bindings and a frozen inventory qualification assessment; qualification establishes inspectability/relevance of subject, not support or truth.
proof_available.true_rule: Complete reviewed inventory enumerates at least one qualifying bound object with retrievable matching bytes and complete qualification assessment.
proof_available.false_rule: The complete reviewed inventory explicitly attests NO_QUALIFYING_PROOF, enumerates the inspected scope and records all objects as nonqualifying with reasons (or explicitly attests an empty scope).
proof_available.block_rule: Missing inventory, incomplete inspected scope, uncertain qualification, contradictory inventory statements, missing referenced object, hash mismatch or unknown binding blocks; absence of a file is never a negative assessment.
proof_available.instantiation: Only independently authored finite synthetic records/derivations and explicit qualification assessments permitted by approved scope; no proof generation from evaluator outputs.

proof_supports_claim.SUPPORTS: An independent frozen assessment provides a complete explicit mapping from the qualifying witness/derivation assertions to every bounded claim obligation with matching subjects, scope and qualifiers; proof_available must be true. Human reviews the mapping and its rule justifications independently of evaluator behavior.
proof_supports_claim.DOES_NOT_SUPPORT: A complete assessment names at least one unsupported or contradicted obligation with an explicit gap/counterexample. If the authoritative inventory explicitly says NO_QUALIFYING_PROOF, a separate assessment may explicitly record NO_SUPPORT_NO_QUALIFYING_PROOF; this yields false, not an implicit default.
proof_supports_claim.BLOCK_UNRESOLVED: Missing assessment, unassessed obligations, unresolved relation, ambiguous scope, inconsistent assessment or broken source integrity blocks; even an identified negative obligation does not excuse an incomplete assessment.
proof_supports_claim.universal_human_rule: A qualifying documentary object cannot by itself establish an unbounded universal assertion or discharge human discretion. An explicit complete assessment may record DOES_NOT_SUPPORT for that reason; do not generate this value from the family alone.

authority_present.qualification: An explicit synthetic documentary authority object identifies fictional issuer, grantee, request and permission-record subject, tool/action scope, effective interval and grant/delegation identity. Presence means an inspectable object of an admitted class, not that its issuer or grant is valid.
authority_present.binding: Exact case_id + fixture_id + request identity + permission record identity; partial or ambiguous subject matching blocks.
authority_present.true_rule: Complete frozen authority inventory explicitly identifies at least one qualifying bound object whose bytes/hash resolve.
authority_present.false_rule: Complete authoritative inventory explicitly records NO_QUALIFYING_AUTHORITY and its examined scope/reasons; not an absent inventory.
authority_present.block_rule: Missing/ambiguous inventory, unresolved subject, corrupt/missing referenced object or incomplete scope -> BLOCK_BEFORE_EVALUATION.

authority_valid.independent_assessment: A frozen validity assessment checks all enumerated obligations against a separately authored finite fictional root-grant registry, delegation chain, revocation ledger and fixed review instant. These are synthetic documentary roles, not operational authority.
obligations: Issuer reaches an explicitly listed fictional root through an acyclic complete delegation chain
Every link grants the exact bound grantee/request/tool/action scope and cannot expand parent scope
Fixed review instant lies within all effective intervals (inclusive start, exclusive end)
Complete bound revocation ledger explicitly records no revocation effective at or before the review instant
authority_valid.true_rule: authority_present true and independent complete assessment explicitly finds every obligation satisfied for at least one bound authority chain; all reviewed inventory objects have resolved assessments.
authority_valid.false_rule: Independent complete assessment explicitly finds every qualifying chain invalid with a witnessed failed obligation, or explicitly records NO_VALID_AUTHORITY against a complete NO_QUALIFYING_AUTHORITY inventory.
authority_valid.block_rule: Any unknown chain status, incomplete registry/revocation scope, absent validity assessment, time ambiguity or broken binding blocks. No wall-clock dependence, inherited validity or false by absence.

duplicate_lineage.scope: Finite frozen set of evidence items presented as separate corroboration, with complete derivation edges and independently attested origin events. Human reviews origin equivalence statements; names/IDs alone are not equivalence evidence.
duplicate_lineage.duplicate: At least two separately counted items trace through fully resolved derivation edges to the same attested origin event, or to origin events explicitly established equivalent by an independent provenance assessment. Require an explicit pair/path witness.
duplicate_lineage.distinct: Complete reviewed scope resolves every origin/path and every relevant origin equivalence assessment; all separately counted items have disjoint, explicitly non-equivalent origins. Empty/single-item scope needs an explicit complete negative assessment.
duplicate_lineage.incomplete: Unknown origin equivalence, missing edges, cycles, unreviewed items or absent negative assessment -> BLOCK_BEFORE_EVALUATION even if another pair appears duplicated.
duplicate_lineage.instantiation: Use only explicit origin and transformation evidence; do not deduplicate records to manufacture a negative finding.

tool_permission.granted: Bound frozen synthetic permission record explicitly states ALLOW for its covered tool/action and request subject at the frozen assessment version.
tool_permission.denied: The same type of record explicitly states DENY for that subject and covered tool/action.
tool_permission.unknown: An intact bound record explicitly states UNDETERMINED with reason; never inferred from absence or an empty status.
tool_permission.block: Missing/ambiguous/corrupt/unbound or conflicting multiple records, unknown enum, or unreviewed version -> BLOCK_BEFORE_EVALUATION. No grant/deny priority fallback.
tool_permission.tool_scope: Status refers to the record's covered tool/action. requested_tool may differ from record_tool; preserve the mismatch as evidence for the evaluator, never repair it or infer permission from equality.
tool_permission.authority_distinction: A recorded ALLOW does not establish authority_valid; that requires its independent assessment.

stage_1_semantic_designs.requested_tool_record_tool: Exact permitted enum values explicitly authored in their independently bound synthetic request and permission records, respectively; never choose from a name, expected result or the other record. Action review is the existing branch-only literal, not evidence that the record exists.

global_source_rules.negative_evidence_rule: False requires an explicit negative assessment by the human-approved frozen evidence policy; missing, ambiguous, corrupt or unbound evidence is not a negative assessment.
global_source_rules.integrity_gate: Source integrity, hashes, exact identity and fixture binding must pass before any semantic value, including false or unknown, is usable.
global_source_rules.independence: Sources and expected values/digests must be frozen independently of adaptive payload emission, evaluator/oracle outcomes, feedback and performance.

source_policies.semantic_definition: Human-approved verifier-family classification of this exact synthetic claim, not its lexical label or an inferred outcome.
source_policies.evidence_object: Frozen mapping record containing exact case_id + fixture_id, claim reference/hash, assigned family, classification policy/version and independent semantic justification.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Exactly one case_id + fixture_id -> claim_family mapping bound to the claim evidence object/hash.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: The mapping explicitly names the approved non-holdout fixture_id; no reuse across fixtures by case_id alone.
source_policies.validation_rule: Reject unknown family, zero/multiple bindings or absent approved policy. Never map logical_family by string equality. Derive claim_universality only after this source is resolved.

source_policies.semantic_definition: Whether all human-approved semantic lineage and attribution obligations for this candidate claim/evidence bundle are demonstrably satisfied; separate from source transport integrity.
source_policies.evidence_object: Independent frozen semantic completeness assessment listing every obligation, its status and exact evidence references under semantic_completeness_policy.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Assessment names case_id + fixture_id and hashes of the exact claim/evidence bundle evaluated.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: All referenced assessments explicitly match the approved non-holdout fixture; cross-fixture evidence needs separately approved explicit binding.
source_policies.validation_rule: True only if all obligations are SATISFIED. False only with an explicit UNSATISFIED obligation and no missing/unknown assessment. Missing or unknown status blocks before evaluation.
source_policies.explicit_false_evidence: An intact, bound authoritative ledger records at least one known semantic obligation as UNSATISFIED, with reasons and all required assessments present.

source_policies.semantic_definition: Availability of a qualifying proof for the exact candidate claim under a human-approved proof qualification policy.
source_policies.evidence_object: Approved frozen proof inventory entry binding the candidate claim to a qualifying proof object/hash, or explicitly attesting NO_QUALIFYING_PROOF under that same policy.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Inventory entry identifies case_id + fixture_id and claim reference/hash; proof reference must resolve exactly if availability is true.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: Inventory and entry explicitly cover the same approved non-holdout fixture_id.
source_policies.validation_rule: True requires the candidate-bound qualifying proof object to exist with matching bytes/hash. False requires an explicit authoritative negative entry. An absent inventory, missing proof object, invalid hash or missing binding blocks.
source_policies.explicit_false_evidence: The same authoritative inventory explicitly records NO_QUALIFYING_PROOF for this claim under the approved policy.

source_policies.semantic_definition: A separately frozen support relationship between the exact candidate claim and its referenced proof, according to a human-approved support policy.
source_policies.evidence_object: Independent support assessment binding claim hash, proof hash or explicit inventory negative reference, support policy/version, result and justification.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Assessment binds case_id + fixture_id and the same claim/proof references used by proof_available.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: Support assessment, inventory and claim explicitly share the same approved fixture binding.
source_policies.validation_rule: True requires proof_available = true and an explicit supportive relationship. Existence of proof alone proves no support. False requires an explicit negative assessment, including the no-qualifying-proof case only if the approved policy explicitly covers it. No evaluator-derived support.
source_policies.explicit_false_evidence: Frozen assessment explicitly records no support for the bound claim/proof relationship under the approved policy; never infer false from a missing relationship record.

source_policies.semantic_definition: Pass/fail of an explicitly identified candidate-bound evidence object against its human-approved frozen schema and validator, not validity of the adaptive input envelope.
source_policies.evidence_object: Completed validation assessment containing evidence object type/identity/hash, schema identity/hash, validator identity/version/hash, configuration, deterministic outcome and binding.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Subject evidence object and assessment bind exactly to case_id + fixture_id; subject cannot be G3BAdaptiveEvaluatorInputV1 itself.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: Evidence object and validation assessment identify the approved non-holdout fixture_id.
source_policies.validation_rule: Completed PASS maps to true; completed schema FAIL maps to false only under approved interpretation. Validator error, incomplete assessment, missing schema/version/hash or unbound object blocks. Reject adaptive-input self-validation as circular.
source_policies.explicit_false_evidence: A complete candidate-bound validation assessment records a schema FAIL for the separately identified evidence object, not an execution error.

source_policies.semantic_definition: Proposed fraction of explicitly contradictory assertion pairs in a complete finite candidate-bound comparison scope, per contradiction_score_source_decision.proposed_design; subject to human approval, never a confidence score, reward or structural identity value.
source_policies.evidence_object: Independent frozen scoring assessment containing the claim/evidence references, scoring semantics identity/version/hash, exact expected numeric value and independently approved reference digest.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Assessment and independent expected value/digest are bound to the exact case_id + fixture_id and scored evidence hashes.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: Scoring assessment explicitly names the approved fixture; no derivation from fixture/case ordering.
source_policies.validation_rule: Require finite value in [0,1] matching independently frozen expected value/digest and approved scoring semantics. No historical structural fingerprint reuse by name. The existing evaluator threshold does not define or supply a score.
source_policies.explicit_false_evidence: NOT_IN_DOMAIN; numeric zero requires explicit evidence and is not missing/false

source_policies.semantic_definition: Tool explicitly named by the candidate-bound synthetic request record.
source_policies.evidence_object: Frozen synthetic request record with request identity/hash, tool, action and exact candidate/fixture binding.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Unique request record names case_id + fixture_id and the relevant synthetic claim/request.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: Request explicitly belongs to the approved non-holdout fixture_id.
source_policies.validation_rule: Read exact tool from approved record; require permitted enum and request binding. Do not copy record_tool to force equality. Existing requested_action literal review remains unchanged.

source_policies.semantic_definition: Tool explicitly covered by the candidate-bound synthetic permission record.
source_policies.evidence_object: Frozen synthetic permission record with record identity/hash, covered tool/action and exact binding to candidate/request/fixture.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Unique permission record names case_id + fixture_id and binds to the exact request subject.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: Permission record belongs to the same approved non-holdout fixture_id as the request.
source_policies.validation_rule: Read exact covered tool from the approved record. Mismatch with requested_tool is valid evidence, not a reason to repair input. Existing record_action literal review remains unchanged.

source_policies.semantic_definition: Presence of qualifying fictional authority evidence for the exact synthetic request/record under a human-approved presence policy; never real operational authority.
source_policies.evidence_object: Frozen synthetic authority inventory/assessment explicitly identifying qualifying authority evidence or its assessed absence for the candidate request/record.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Authority inventory entry binds case_id + fixture_id and the exact request/permission record identities.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: Inventory assessment and synthetic authority subject share the approved fixture_id.
source_policies.validation_rule: True requires exact qualifying authority evidence. False requires explicit assessed absence; missing inventory blocks. Preserve authority_valid = true -> authority_present = true.
source_policies.explicit_false_evidence: Approved inventory explicitly attests no qualifying synthetic authority evidence for the bound subject.

source_policies.semantic_definition: Validity of the exact synthetic authority evidence for the bound request/record under an independently approved validity policy.
source_policies.evidence_object: Frozen synthetic authority validity assessment with subject identity/hash, policy/version, outcome and reason; an absent-authority outcome needs an explicit policy-backed assessment.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Assessment binds case_id + fixture_id and the same authority subject/inventory entry used for authority_present.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: Validity assessment and authority evidence explicitly match the approved fixture_id.
source_policies.validation_rule: True implies authority_present = true and an explicit valid assessment. False needs an explicit negative assessment, not absence of the validity record. Unknown or inconsistent assessments block.
source_policies.explicit_false_evidence: Independent policy-backed assessment explicitly records invalid or no-valid-authority status for this bound subject.

source_policies.semantic_definition: Whether the candidate evidence lineage contains duplication under a human-approved lineage equivalence/duplication criterion; not repeated case IDs alone.
source_policies.evidence_object: Frozen synthetic lineage graph and complete duplicate assessment identifying examined nodes/edges, criterion/version and positive or negative result.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Graph roots and assessed evidence nodes explicitly bind case_id + fixture_id and the candidate evidence bundle hashes.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: Graph and assessment declare the approved fixture_id and scope examined; no silent cross-fixture lineage reuse.
source_policies.validation_rule: True needs an explicit duplicate witness under the approved criterion. False needs an explicit complete negative assessment. Partial graph, missing criterion or missing binding blocks; do not infer from names or counts.
source_policies.explicit_false_evidence: Complete, bound lineage assessment explicitly finds no duplicate under the approved criterion and frozen examined scope.

source_policies.semantic_definition: Explicit synthetic permission state recorded for the candidate request/tool/action under the approved interpretation of the permission record.
source_policies.evidence_object: Frozen synthetic permission record and interpretation policy identifying the exact request/tool/action and granted, denied or explicitly unknown status.
source_policies.candidate_binding_requirement: Permission state binds case_id + fixture_id to the exact request and permission record identities used by requested_tool and record_tool.
source_policies.fixture_binding_requirement: State assessment and request/record explicitly share the same approved non-holdout fixture_id.
source_policies.validation_rule: Use only an explicit permitted status from the bound source. Unknown is permitted only when explicitly recorded by the approved source; absent permission evidence blocks rather than becoming unknown or denied.
source_policies.explicit_false_evidence: NOT_IN_DOMAIN; denied is an explicit enum value, not a missing/false default

claim_family_source_decision.stage_2_requirement: Review the instantiated exact mapping artifact and any demonstrated semantic equivalence, with hashes and case_id + fixture_id record locators. Stage 1 does not accept an existing source automatically.
claim_family_source_decision.equivalence_requirement: Human-approved evidence must show that an existing source's classification semantics and exact candidate/fixture bindings are identical to the approved claim family meaning. Lexical equality is insufficient.

semantic_completeness_policy.scope: Semantic attribution and lineage of the exact candidate claim/evidence bundle, not availability of qualifying proof or validity of the adaptive transport envelope.

obligations.requirement: The claim's origin and responsible synthetic assertion source are explicitly identified under the approved policy.
Every evidence item in the declared candidate evidence scope has explicit origin and attribution; explicit negative inventories are assessed records, not missing files.
Each evidence item or negative inventory assertion has an explicit relationship to the exact claim it describes.
All declared transformations/derivations have identifiable inputs, rules and lineage; explicitly recorded absence of a semantic lineage fact is UNSATISFIED.
An independent assessment explicitly covers the complete approved evidence scope with no unassessed or unknown obligation.

semantic_completeness_policy.true_rule: Every obligation explicitly SATISFIED in the intact candidate-bound assessment.
semantic_completeness_policy.false_rule: Every obligation assessed with no UNKNOWN or missing entries, and at least one explicit UNSATISFIED finding with reason/evidence.
semantic_completeness_policy.distinction: A fully intact, hash-verified source may explicitly attest incomplete semantic lineage and yield false. A broken source hash or missing assessment always blocks; it never yields false.

schema_valid_subject_decision.rejection_reason: Self-validation is circular and would erase legitimate schema_valid = false evidence states among admitted inputs.

proposed_design.evidence_object_type: SYNTHETIC_ASSERTION_DOCUMENT_V1: a separately stored fictional evidence document, never the adaptive input or source manifest. It may be structurally invalid while its external candidate binding remains intact.
proposed_design.schema_design: Closed JSON object with exactly document_id (nonempty string), synthetic (literal true), and assertions (nonempty array). Each assertion is a closed object with exactly subject, predicate, scope, value (nonempty strings) and polarity (AFFIRM or DENY). Reject additional/missing keys, wrong types, nulls and empty strings/arrays. Nonempty means contains at least one non-whitespace character; do not trim or coerce. Duplicate keys are invalid. No references to adaptive input fields or outcomes.
proposed_design.validator_semantics_design: Read separately bound document bytes; reject encoding or JSON syntax errors as an explicit completed document FAIL if bytes and external binding are intact. Otherwise check the exact closed shape and domains above deterministically. Structural PASS does not assert evidence truth. Failure to obtain/verify bytes, internal validator error, resource limit or missing configuration is BLOCK, never false.
proposed_design.validator_configuration_design: Offline UTF-8 (no BOM), duplicate-key rejection, exact case-sensitive keys/enums, no coercion/defaults/property stripping/network resolution, immutable input. Resource ceilings: 1048576 bytes, nesting depth 16, 10000 assertions, 4096 characters per string; exceeding a ceiling is incomplete validation and BLOCK, not document FAIL. Freeze validator implementation/version/configuration hashes at Stage 2.
proposed_design.pass_fail_interpretation: Completed validation PASS -> true; completed syntax/shape/domain FAIL -> false with exact failure evidence. Missing/corrupt source, unresolved external binding, execution error or incomplete validation -> BLOCK_BEFORE_EVALUATION.
proposed_design.case_id_fixture_id_binding_design: Independent manifest record binds case_id + fixture_id to document identity, byte hash, approved schema/validator identities and assessment. The external binding must pass even when document body is malformed. Never use document self-assertion as binding proof.

proposed_design.scoring_semantics_definition: Score is C/N for a finite nonempty complete comparison scope of N explicitly reviewed claim/evidence assertion pairs, C of which are CONTRADICTS. Zero means no pair contradicts in this scope, not absence of proof or universal consistency. One means every pair contradicts. Intermediate values are fractions of contradicting pairs, not calibrated probability, confidence, severity or performance.
proposed_design.admissible_scoring_evidence_object_type: A separately frozen finite comparison ledger links each unique claim assertion/evidence assertion pair to their exact immutable sources, semantic scope and a reviewed relation with rationale. Human approves the complete enumerated scope before scoring; software cannot invent pair membership or semantic labels.

relation_criteria.CONTRADICTS: Same explicitly reviewed subject, predicate, scope and value but opposite polarity, or mutually exclusive values under an explicitly frozen human-reviewed exclusion axiom for the same subject/predicate/scope.
relation_criteria.DOES_NOT_CONTRADICT: Complete human-reviewed pair assessment explicitly establishes no such opposition/exclusion in the declared scope, with rationale. This is not a proof-support finding.
relation_criteria.UNRESOLVED: Unknown meaning, scope/equivalence, axiom, relation or incomplete assessment; blocks the entire score even if another pair contradicts.

proposed_design.scoring_instantiation_rules: Use exact independently human-reviewed pair identities/relations; duplicate pair identities block rather than deduplicate. Require N > 0, every pair assessed, source integrity and complete scope attestation. Count integer N and C; compute C/N with ECMAScript IEEE-754 binary64 division, no rounding, clipping or weighting. N must be a safe positive integer. Empty/missing scope, missing assertion sources, ambiguous relation or non-finite result blocks. Do not invent a score for proof absence or derive one from claim_family.
proposed_design.case_id_fixture_id_binding_design: Ledger binds exact case_id + fixture_id, immutable claim/evidence assertion references, approved scope and scoring policy version; no reuse of historical structural fingerprint input or index-based values.
proposed_design.independent_expected_value_and_digest_pr: Before any runtime payload exists, a separate reviewer verifies ledger membership, all relation judgments, counts N/C and expected numeric C/N. Freeze those counts/value in source-review evidence and hash exact raw ledger/assessment bytes. INDEPENDENT_EXPECTED_INPUT_DERIVATION then uses that frozen value for the canonical full-input reference digest. Never derive expected values from evaluator/oracle/runtime output, feedback or performance.
proposed_design.limitation: A candidate without a legitimate nonempty complete comparison scope stays blocked until new human scoring-design review; software may not assign zero. This proposal changes no current evaluator threshold and is not an approved semantic policy yet.

candidate_binding_rules.uniqueness: Exactly one frozen record for the full key and approved semantic source version; zero or multiple matches block.
candidate_binding_rules.historical_case_fingerprint: Verify against the approved identity reference; never overwrite or reinterpret it as a complete payload hash.
candidate_binding_rules.claim_identity: Every assessment must reference the exact claim/evidence objects and hashes, not merely a textual family label.
candidate_binding_rules.fixture_identity: Require explicit approved non-holdout fixture reference and membership evidence; never use first fixture, case prefix, index or lexical inference.
candidate_binding_rules.outside_permission_branch: No permission-only input fields or evaluator dependencies. Inactive source policies do not synthesize permission data or require nonexistent permission records.
candidate_binding_rules.action_literals: requested_action and record_action remain frozen review literals only on permission branch; literals do not establish the existence of request/record evidence.
candidate_binding_rules.tool_mismatch: requested_tool != record_tool is admissible sourced evidence, not a structural failure or repair request.
candidate_binding_rules.source_integrity: All source artifacts must be explicitly approved, local, synthetic, immutable and hash-verified; reject network paths, path escape, unapproved fixtures, partial snapshots and ambiguous locators.

source_manifest_proposal.human_decision_commit_semantics: The manifest entry references the immutable Stage-1 semantic design approval commit permitting its instantiation; this reference alone cannot substitute for source approval. Stage-2 acceptance is recorded externally against exact source/manifest hashes, never embedded in the bytes it accepts. 141c879 remains only the earlier input boundary approval.
source_manifest_proposal.active_field_coverage: All 9 active non-permission fields or all 17 permission fields: include source locations for semantic fields plus frozen literal/rule references and derivation dependencies for structural fields. Omitted historical fields are not added to the adaptive input.
source_manifest_proposal.source_artifact_hashes: SHA-256 of exact raw bytes for every referenced artifact and dependency, including proof inventory, assessments, schemas, validators and policies where applicable.
source_manifest_proposal.candidate_binding_evidence: Unique source record locators plus exact case/fixture/claim/evidence bindings and explicit independent attestations; no self-attestation by the evaluator payload.
source_manifest_proposal.expected_fingerprint_scope: SHA-256 over the complete approved adaptive input's canonical UTF-8 JSON using the reviewed sorted-key mechanics. Historical case_fingerprint remains separate.
source_manifest_proposal.expected_fingerprint_authority: An independently reviewed freeze process and human approval establish the expected digest in a separately hash-pinned manifest before runtime use. The emitter may only compare a computed digest, never certify or replace the expected value.
source_manifest_proposal.hash_cycle_avoidance: Payload does not contain the manifest or expected digest. Freeze manifest bytes after independent digest approval; record manifest hash in an external approval/reference, never in a self-hashed entry.
source_manifest_proposal.staged_digest_rule: Stage 1 may approve INDEPENDENT_EXPECTED_INPUT_DERIVATION for source-review evidence only; Stage 2 reviews its exact reference representation, expected digest and derivation dependencies. Reference canonical representation != executable runtime payload. If independence or full legitimate source coverage fails, Stage 2 remains incomplete; never construct an executable payload to supply its own expected digest.

Approved true/false/block interpretation and value domain

human_resolution_rules.partial_approval: Partial per-decision approvals grant nothing. Only explicitly signed aggregate Stage-1 APPROVE with all 14 approved, consistent, fully resolved design decisions and valid derived scope/integrity authority permits source instantiation. No source acceptance, runtime payload or implementation authority is inferred; Stage-2 acceptance and subsequent separate implementation authorization remain required.

baseline_protection.hash_reference: implementation_design.source_basis pins runtime, evaluator, schema, domain, random/rule_based configurations, exposure and stopping rules

independent_expected_input_derivation.name: INDEPENDENT_EXPECTED_INPUT_DERIVATION
independent_expected_input_derivation.prerequisite: Valid derived Stage-1 source-instantiation authority explicitly covering this procedure and exact scoped synthetic sources instantiated under the approved policies. This packet's pending state authorizes no derivation.
independent_expected_input_derivation.output: Non-executable canonical reference representation and independent expected SHA-256 only, stored as source-review evidence with provenance. reference canonical representation != executable runtime payload.
procedure: Independent reviewer checks every active source value against the approved policy and exact case_id + fixture_id sources without using runtime output

Assemble a documentary reference table containing all 9 active non-permission or 17 permission fields with per-field evidence; validate all approved domains, invariants and scope without invoking the evaluator
Serialize the reference values using the existing reviewed sorted-key recursive canonical mechanics, ordered arrays, JSON.stringify finite numbers and UTF-8 without a trailing newline
Hash canonical reference bytes with SHA-256; freeze lowercase hexadecimal digest, reference bytes, source hashes, derivation identity and review attestation before any runtime comparison
Submit exact reference and manifest dependencies for separate Stage-2 review; future runtime may compare only against these independently accepted expectations
independent_expected_input_derivation.separation: Use a separately reviewed reference derivation path and storage role, never runtime payload constructor, runtime input queue or execution artifact. Identical canonical values do not confer runtime authority. Source-review role and provenance must remain explicit and cannot be relabeled silently.
independent_expected_input_derivation.independence_requirement: Reviewer verifies source-to-reference values and digest independently of runtime construction. Reusing reviewed canonical hashing mechanics is permitted; using actual runtime-produced values as expected values is not.

post_stage_2_implementation_gate.name: RETURN_FOR_NON_HOLDOUT_IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZATION
post_stage_2_implementation_gate.eligible_sources_rule: Derived Stage-2 source acceptance makes only the exact reviewed values eligible for later work; it is not implementation permission.
post_stage_2_implementation_gate.separate_authority_rule: A future explicit human implementation decision must be separately signed/dated, bound to an exact allowed implementation scope and source/design snapshots, pass independent integrity and consistency checks, and require valid current Stage-2 authority. Only that separately derived authority may enable the specifically approved implementation activities. No bare boolean or Stage-2 approval can substitute.

stage_1_review_readiness.meaning: Complete proposed definitions are available for human acceptance/rejection; this is not readiness to sign an unresolved or partially approved packet.
remaining_human_actions: Instantiate exact synthetic sources within the approved finite non-holdout scope
Submit frozen source artifacts, locators, hashes and independent expected values for separate Stage-2 review
stage_1_review_readiness.principle: Code may implement a design decision. Code may not make a design decision.

validation_scope: Decision metadata, source-policy completeness, candidate-binding requirements, adapter impact statements and existing hashes only. These checks do not validate future evidence truth, implement a validator or evaluate an adaptive candidate.
